fingerprintFormat: SHA256 of UTF8 source normalized to LF; sourceBlobs are the actual HEAD Git objects after verifying normalized content equality. Git blobs may preserve CRLF. Includes the transitive JavaScript dependencies of engine and sandbox.
setup: Native18x32 field. Red preset at(168,304), deployed and frozen; blue full card at(168,472), retaining deployment delay. Production30Hz.
scope: Every selectable troop and all three offensive structures against Knight, Princess Tower, Golem and Pekka. Exchange ends at first defeated root family (including explicit descendants) or tower death; later push is separate. Non-interacting bodies marked at t0. A surviving tower has its real HP/state.
referenceControls: Raw native fields for every mapped body; independent stationary melee oracle; source-derived Dart3hits, Princess AoE, all12Graveyard actions, Golem children, GoblinHut, Furnace and21Tornado pulls at30/60Hz. See tests/native*. Representative independent controls, not a complete native path/spawn oracle.
limits: Rollouts measure this game. Original cards are not counted as native comparisons.
Exact-time melee ties favor the first-created actor in runtime and the first argument in the helper. Mirror tests check this convention, not the native simultaneous-hit rule.

Projectile conversion is independently measured on client16.402; the data rows are16.635. Steering/contact order and cross-version trace coverage retain documented limits. Raw-stat agreement does not establish universal trade identity.
